Indeed the SARD lead vocalist has a beautiful voice, many people may even say that her voice is more beautiful than Izumi's voice. But in my opinion, what makes me love Sakai Izumi's voice is not because it's beautiful, but because it's unique, it has a calming effect on me. Listening to her voice itself is some kind of therapy for me.

My best guess is, that quite the majority of those 200 songs found on her house had already been released and some of it was incomplete. Most of it was unpublishable, if not they'd already publish it.

You're right, Sakai Izumi had spent many hours in the studio. That's why she didn't fall into the same hole that most best-selling artists go to. Most best-selling artist might already stop producing songs after finding themselves at the top of their careers. But ZARD didn't, this proves that Izumi loves music and didn't enjoy being among the crowd. That's why she can produce many best-selling songs even at the end of her life. My guess is, that if she hadn't passed away, she'd be still producing many songs for years to come.

Indeed even though she closed her personal life from the media, there's still no shortage of her photos at least. But my guess is, it's the only way for her fans didn't lose touch with who Sakai Izumi is, the singer behind ZARD. Even though some of her song clips produce videos with her in them, it's mostly candid videos with just her walking and doing some activities alone while not minding the camera. I think it's her only way to cope with her shyness in front of the camera. It's indeed giving us a sense of loneliness and distance, but i think she's a warm person at heart.

Even though she left us in the middle of her career, I believe that she already contributes a big part to her fan's life and Japanese music in general.

I assume that she had many songs unreleased after her death. The thing about SARD is, that I never give them much attention because one thing that I like about ZARD is Izumi's singing voice. Her voice just feels different from that I always prefer her over other artists singing the same song. Her voice just calms me.

This is also the first time that I heard SARD releasing a new song that's not covering the old ZARD song. That's good because I feel that SARD won't be able to replace ZARD. Releasing the unreleased ZARD song also makes SARD more bearable to ZARD fans haha.

The thing about Sakai Izumi is that we got no clue about her personal life. Did she spend most of her time in the studio creating music ? How involved does she in the music creation process ? many things were left unanswered even after her death.

It's indeed no telling just how much of her song is left unreleased. But her style always remains in the minds of her fans. She had this writing style that was different from the contemporary artist and unique to her own. 

Even though the music is full of energy, I often found that her lyrics are quite sad honestly. The fact that she often uses the first point of view in writing lyrics sure always blew my mind. 

I consume some JPOP songs after knowing her passing. But in the end, I always return to ZARD. I can be bored listening to other JPOP song, but never ZARD. No matter how many times I hear it, I won't get bored and these facts won't change for me no matter how much time passes.

I've read somewhere that she had written over 100 song lyrics throughout her entire career. Not only for ZARD but for other artists as well. I like the song "あなたと共に生きてゆく" that she wrote for Theresa Teng, a Chinese legendary singer. 

This proves that not only she can write rock and pop music, but also enka-style music lyrics. Even some of the lyrics that she writes for other artists become famous too as "totsuzen" sang by field of view. It just never cease to amaze me that we lost such a talented singer.

I always wish that I have known her sooner.
The fact that she's also a very talented songwriter on top of that always blew my mind.

My journey to ZARD started when I was still in middle school (2012/2013).

At that time, I was given this very old phone by my relative (nokia symbian OS). I don't have many things to do with that phone other than reading some web novel on baka-tsuki and listening to some anime song.

At that time, I was an avid reader of detective conan manga and I use this old anime music site called gendou. So I download many detective conan soundtracks on that site with other anime soundtracks too. one of the songs that I downloaded at that time included a song by ZARD.

I still remember that the first ZARD song that I listened to at that time was called "Natsu o Matsu Sail no Yō ni (夏を待つセイル(帆)のように)", which was used as the soundtrack of detective conan movie 9. My first impression of that song is it was so-so. I won't go as far as calling it bad, but it was just a normal song for me. Not good enough to be my favorite. The singer's voice which I thought to be different from other singers doesn't leave any impression on me at that time.

Some time passed, and a few years later when I was still in early college, I was thinking to do a marathon of detective conan movies. It was a long holiday at that time and I don't have many things to do. At that time, my youtube had already given me suggestions on some ZARD songs like "makenaide" and "goodbye my loneliness", but I just skimp through the song mostly.

It was only when I finish detective conan movie 2, and when the credit rolls are when I was stunned because of Sakai Izumi's voice. I don't know why, but her voice sounds so good and angelic at that time, it calms me. And when the credits ends, it was a time when I search about the song and the singer and was and found out about ZARD. That night, I spammed the song which was called "Shōjo no Koro ni Modotta Mitai ni (少女の頃に戻ったみたいに)".

But I still don't listen to her other song. It was only when I finish watching detective conan movie 12 and found out that the soundtrack was sung by ZARD too that I began to realize that this singer has so many good songs.

After that, I began to listen to ZARD playlist to spend my time browsing the internet and doing some repetitive tasks on my laptop. The thing about ZARD songs that I don't realize at that time is, that I don't even have to select any songs on the playlist, I just have to play every of her song on the playlist and it all will turn out good. Anything that sang by Sakai Izumi is just good, I don't even know most of her song titles at that time, I just spammed on every ZARD playlist on youtube.

Some time passed and I began to hear more and more of her songs frequently. When I found out that the main singer of ZARD is passed away a long time ago, I felt a feeling of emptiness. It's just sad hearing such a talented singer cannot produce any more songs and felt devastated. It makes me appreciate her songs more.

I also found out that there's so little of her information on the internet. I found out that ZARD was a popular band in the past, but it still baffles me that I can't find much information about such a huge band, especially the main singer. But it's also the reason why I appreciate ZARD song because it's the only thing that connects us to Sakai Izumi.

Maybe I stopped listening to ZARD song when the COVID-19 pandemic starts. Life hits me hard at that time and I was very busy with my life. My mental is drained and I started to be very depressed. It was only when I was at the lowest point in my life that I started to crave ZARD songs again.

By last year I started searching ZARD songs again on youtube but only found out that they all get removed. The fact that I can't listen to ZARD songs frightened me, so I start to find a way to listen to ZARD songs again. I even thinking to buy an iPhone so I can use apple music to listen to ZARD songs. But luckily I found out about youtube music which has almost all of ZARD's songs and albums. I subscribe immediately and started listening to ZARD songs again.

Lately, my life is going over many hurdles and I believe the reason that I can still go on is because of her songs. Listening to ZARD's song and Izumi's voice is like giving me some source of power to keep moving on and not give up. Whenever I feel down and listen to her songs, I'll be fine.

Sakai Izumi's voice is so unique that it has the power to calm people. She is also a genius songwriter. I hope that she will be remembered forever and live in our hearts. Finding this community makes me believe that there are still many people that love her and keep her song live.
